mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome to a journey where curiosity meets creativity, and where a playful urge to tinker can change the world. Have you ever wondered what happens when someone looks at a piece of technology and just can’t help but take it apart, eager to see how it all works? That’s exactly the spirit that pulses through the pages of Steve Wozniak’s story—captured in iWoz: Computer Geek to Cult Icon. Together, we’ll explore the excitement of discovery, the pure joy of building things just for the sake of it, and the thrill that comes from facing a problem and thinking, “What if I try something different?” This isn’t just a tale about computer chips and wires—it’s about seeing possibilities where others see limits, and about daring to challenge the status quo. As we trace the path from those first experiments with circuits all the way to the co-founding of Apple, you’ll feel the energy of collaboration, the fun of shared ideas, and the courage it takes to follow a dream—even when it seems impossible. By the end of this journey, you’ll see how passion, perseverance, and a little bit of playful rebellion can turn a simple hobby into something that shapes an entire generation. So, let’s dive in together, and rediscover the magic that happens when you follow your curiosity and let your imagination lead the way.
